```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
```

```{r data_and_scores}
project_dir <- project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/RMD files")
imc_file <- project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/IMC spe objects/New IMC/spe2025-12-17 umap.RData")
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "imc_protein_score_outputs")
scmetab_output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "scmetabolism_outputs")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

if (!exists("spe")) {
  load(imc_file)
}

score_assay <- "zrescaled"
if (!score_assay %in% SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(spe)) {
  stop("The IMC spe object does not contain assay 'zrescaled'.")
}

glycolysis <- c("GLUT1", "HK1", "PFKL1_PFKM", "PKM2", "LDHA", "GAPDH")
tca_oxphos <- c("CS", "OGDH", "ATP5A", "SDHA")

pathway_markers <- list(
  "Glycolysis" = glycolysis,
  "TCA / OXPHOS" = tca_oxphos
)

marker_status <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pathway_markers), function(pathway_name) {
  data.frame(
    pathway = pathway_name,
    marker = pathway_markers[[pathway_name]],
    available = pathway_markers[[pathway_name]] %in% rownames(spe),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

missing_pathways <- marker_status %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_available = sum(available), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_available == 0)

if (nrow(missing_pathways) > 0) {
  stop("No IMC markers were found for: ", paste(missing_pathways$pathway, collapse = ", "))
}

make_imc_protein_score <- function(markers) {
  markers <- intersect(markers, rownames(spe))
  colMeans(as.matrix(SummarizedExperiment::assay(spe, score_assay)[markers, , drop = FALSE]), na.rm = TRUE)
}

score_wide <- as.data.frame(
  vapply(pathway_markers, make_imc_protein_score, numeric(ncol(spe))),
  check.names = FALSE
)
score_wide$cell <- colnames(spe)

if ("sample_id" %in% colnames(SummarizedExperiment::colData(spe))) {
  score_wide$sample_id <- as.character(spe$sample_id)
} else {
  score_wide$sample_id <- NA_character_
}

if (!"Rphenograph_500" %in% colnames(SummarizedExperiment::colData(spe))) {
  stop("The IMC spe object must contain colData(spe)$Rphenograph_500 for fibroblast labels.")
}

if (!"Rphenograph_200EC" %in% colnames(SummarizedExperiment::colData(spe))) {
  stop("The IMC spe object must contain colData(spe)$Rphenograph_200EC for EC labels.")
}

spe$metfiblabel <- dplyr::case_when(
  as.character(spe$Rphenograph_500) %in% c("1", "2") ~ "Met_hi_Fib",
  as.character(spe$Rphenograph_500) == "3" ~ "Other_Fib",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

spe$metEClabel <- dplyr::case_when(
  as.character(spe$Rphenograph_200EC) %in% c("1", "2") ~ "Met_hi_EC",
  as.character(spe$Rphenograph_200EC) == "3" ~ "Met_int_EC",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

analysis <- params$analysis

analysis_config <- switch(
  analysis,
  "fibroblasts" = list(
    label = "Fibroblast",
    group_col = "metfiblabel",
    group_levels = c("Other_Fib", "Met_hi_Fib"),
    group_values = spe$metfiblabel,
    file_prefix = "imc_protein_fibroblast",
    scmetab_cell_joined_file = "scmetabolism_imc_xenium_cell_joined.csv"
  ),
  "endothelial" = list(
    label = "EC",
    group_col = "metEClabel",
    group_levels = c("Met_int_EC", "Met_hi_EC"),
    group_values = spe$metEClabel,
    file_prefix = "imc_protein_ec",
    scmetab_cell_joined_file = "scmetabolism_ec_imc_xenium_cell_joined.csv"
  ),
  stop("Unknown params$analysis. Use 'fibroblasts' or 'endothelial'.")
)

score_wide$group <- as.character(analysis_config$group_values)

score_long <- score_wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), group %in% analysis_config$group_levels) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(names(pathway_markers)),
    names_to = "pathway",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = analysis_config$group_levels),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = names(pathway_markers))
  )

score_summary <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id[!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id != ""]),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = stats::quantile(score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = stats::quantile(score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = stats::sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_score = sd_score / sqrt(n_cells),
    ci95 = 1.96 * se_score,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sample_summary <- score_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(sample_id), sample_id != "") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id, pathway, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells = dplyr::n(),
    mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_summary <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(imc_protein_score),
      is.finite(scmetabolism_score)
    )

  if (nrow(df) < 3) {
    return(data.frame(
      n = nrow(df),
      spearman_rho = NA_real_,
      spearman_p = NA_real_,
      pearson_r = NA_real_,
      pearson_p = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  if (length(unique(df$imc_protein_score)) < 2 || length(unique(df$scmetabolism_score)) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      n = nrow(df),
      spearman_rho = NA_real_,
      spearman_p = NA_real_,
      pearson_r = NA_real_,
      pearson_p = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  spearman_test <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(
    df$imc_protein_score,
    df$scmetabolism_score,
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  ))
  pearson_test <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(
    df$imc_protein_score,
    df$scmetabolism_score,
    method = "pearson"
  ))

  data.frame(
    n = nrow(df),
    spearman_rho = unname(spearman_test$estimate),
    spearman_p = spearman_test$p.value,
    pearson_r = unname(pearson_test$estimate),
    pearson_p = pearson_test$p.value
  )
}

protein_scmetab_joined <- data.frame()
protein_scmetab_cor_long <- data.frame()
protein_scmetab_cor_stats <- data.frame()
scmetab_cell_file <- file.path(scmetab_output_dir, analysis_config$scmetab_cell_joined_file)

if (file.exists(scmetab_cell_file)) {
  scmetab_cell <- read.csv(scmetab_cell_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  required_scmetab_cols <- c(
    "KEY",
    analysis_config$group_col,
    "xenium_glycolysis_score",
    "xenium_tca_score"
  )
  missing_scmetab_cols <- setdiff(required_scmetab_cols, colnames(scmetab_cell))

  if (length(missing_scmetab_cols) == 0) {
    if ("cell" %in% colnames(scmetab_cell)) {
      scmetab_cell$xenium_cell <- as.character(scmetab_cell$cell)
    } else {
      scmetab_cell$xenium_cell <- NA_character_
    }

    if ("sample_id" %in% colnames(scmetab_cell)) {
      scmetab_cell$scmetab_sample_id <- as.character(scmetab_cell$sample_id)
    } else {
      scmetab_cell$scmetab_sample_id <- NA_character_
    }

    scmetab_keep <- scmetab_cell %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        KEY = as.character(KEY),
        xenium_cell,
        scmetab_sample_id,
        scmetab_group = as.character(.data[[analysis_config$group_col]]),
        scmetabolism_glycolysis_score = xenium_glycolysis_score,
        scmetabolism_tca_score = xenium_tca_score
      )

    imc_protein_keep <- score_wide %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        KEY = as.character(cell),
        group = as.character(group)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        KEY,
        imc_cell = cell,
        imc_sample_id = sample_id,
        group,
        imc_protein_glycolysis_score = Glycolysis,
        imc_protein_tca_oxphos_score = `TCA / OXPHOS`
      )

    protein_scmetab_joined <- imc_protein_keep %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(scmetab_keep, by = "KEY") %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        group %in% analysis_config$group_levels,
        scmetab_group %in% analysis_config$group_levels,
        group == scmetab_group
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = analysis_config$group_levels))

    protein_scmetab_cor_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      protein_scmetab_joined %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          KEY,
          imc_cell,
          xenium_cell,
          imc_sample_id,
          scmetab_sample_id,
          group,
          comparison = "Glycolysis",
          imc_protein_score = imc_protein_glycolysis_score,
          scmetabolism_score = scmetabolism_glycolysis_score
        ),
      protein_scmetab_joined %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          KEY,
          imc_cell,
          xenium_cell,
          imc_sample_id,
          scmetab_sample_id,
          group,
          comparison = "TCA / OXPHOS",
          imc_protein_score = imc_protein_tca_oxphos_score,
          scmetabolism_score = scmetabolism_tca_score
        )
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        is.finite(imc_protein_score),
        is.finite(scmetabolism_score)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        group = factor(as.character(group), levels = analysis_config$group_levels),
        comparison = factor(comparison, levels = names(pathway_markers))
      )

    protein_scmetab_cor_stats_by_group <- protein_scmetab_cor_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(comparison, group) %>%
      dplyr::group_modify(~ cor_summary(.x)) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(level = "group")

    protein_scmetab_cor_stats_all <- protein_scmetab_cor_long %>%
      dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
      dplyr::group_modify(~ cor_summary(.x)) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(group = "All matched cells", level = "all")

    protein_scmetab_cor_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      protein_scmetab_cor_stats_by_group,
      protein_scmetab_cor_stats_all
    ) %>%
      dplyr::select(level, comparison, group, dplyr::everything())
  } else {
    warning(
      "Skipping IMC protein vs scMetabolism correlation; missing columns in ",
      scmetab_cell_file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_scmetab_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
} else {
  warning("Skipping IMC protein vs scMetabolism correlation; file not found: ", scmetab_cell_file)
}

write.csv(
  score_long,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_cell_scores.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  score_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_summary.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  sample_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_sample_summary.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  marker_status,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_marker_status.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  protein_scmetab_joined,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_protein_scmetabolism_cell_joined.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  protein_scmetab_cor_long,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_protein_scmetabolism_correlation_long.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  protein_scmetab_cor_stats,
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_protein_scmetabolism_correlation_stats.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

analysis_config$label
```

# `r analysis_config$label` IMC Protein Scores

Scores are the mean of the available IMC `zrescaled` protein markers in each pathway.

```{r marker_status}
kable(marker_status, digits = 3)
```

```{r summary_table}
kable(score_summary, digits = 4)
```

```{r plotting_helpers}
pathway_levels <- names(pathway_markers)
pathway_labels <- c(
  "Glycolysis" = "Glycolysis",
  "TCA / OXPHOS" = "TCA /\nOXPHOS"
)

rescale01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

make_energy_dotplot <- function(summary_df, title, scale_by_column = FALSE) {
  plot_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway = factor(as.character(pathway), levels = rev(pathway_levels)),
      group = factor(as.character(group), levels = analysis_config$group_levels)
    )

  if (isTRUE(scale_by_column)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(pathway) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fill_score = rescale01(mean_score),
        size_score = fill_score
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
    legend_title <- "Column-scaled mean"
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fill_score = mean_score,
        size_score = rescale01(mean_score)
      )
    legend_title <- "Mean IMC protein score"
  }

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = pathway)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = fill_score, size = size_score),
      shape = 21,
      color = "grey35",
      stroke = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = pathway_labels) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#D7301F", name = legend_title) +
    scale_size(range = c(6.5, 12.5), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, lineheight = 0.95),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14.5, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 6, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

save_plot_set <- function(plot, basename, width, height) {
  png_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".png"))
  pdf_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".pdf"))
  svg_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(basename, ".svg"))

  ggsave(png_file, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  grDevices::pdf(pdf_file, width = width, height = height, useDingbats = FALSE, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  grDevices::svg(svg_file, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  invisible(c(png_file, pdf_file, svg_file))
}
```

## Correlation With Xenium scMetabolism

The IMC protein scores above are joined to the Xenium scMetabolism AUCell scores
by the shared IMC/Xenium `KEY`.

```{r protein_scmetabolism_correlation_table}
if (nrow(protein_scmetab_cor_stats) > 0) {
  kable(protein_scmetab_cor_stats, digits = 4)
} else {
  cat("No matched cells were available for IMC protein-score vs Xenium scMetabolism correlation.")
}
```

```{r protein_scmetabolism_correlation_plots, fig.width=8.2, fig.height=5.2}
format_p <- function(p_value) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "p = NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
    TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
}

empty_correlation_plot <- function(title) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No matched cells available", size = 4) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void()
}

if (nrow(protein_scmetab_cor_long) > 0) {
  cor_plot_stats <- protein_scmetab_cor_stats %>%
    dplyr::filter(level == "group") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      comparison = factor(as.character(comparison), levels = names(pathway_markers)),
      group = factor(as.character(group), levels = analysis_config$group_levels),
      label = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ",
        formatC(spearman_rho, format = "f", digits = 2),
        "\n",
        format_p(spearman_p),
        "\nn = ",
        n
      )
    )

  p_protein_scmetab_points <- ggplot(
    protein_scmetab_cor_long,
    aes(x = imc_protein_score, y = scmetabolism_score, color = group)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.25) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.65) +
    geom_label(
      data = cor_plot_stats,
      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = -0.04,
      vjust = 1.08,
      size = 3.1,
      label.size = 0.2,
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    facet_grid(group ~ comparison, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Other_Fib" = "#4E79A7",
      "Met_hi_Fib" = "#E15759",
      "Met_int_EC" = "#4E79A7",
      "Met_hi_EC" = "#E15759"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(analysis_config$label, " IMC protein score vs Xenium scMetabolism"),
      x = "IMC protein score",
      y = "Xenium scMetabolism AUCell score",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  p_protein_scmetab_bins <- ggplot(
    protein_scmetab_cor_long,
    aes(x = imc_protein_score, y = scmetabolism_score)
  ) +
    geom_bin2d(bins = 32) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.65) +
    geom_label(
      data = cor_plot_stats,
      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = -0.04,
      vjust = 1.08,
      size = 3.1,
      label.size = 0.2,
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    facet_grid(group ~ comparison, scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#D7301F", name = "Matched cells") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(analysis_config$label, " binned IMC protein vs scMetabolism correlation"),
      x = "IMC protein score",
      y = "Xenium scMetabolism AUCell score"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
} else {
  p_protein_scmetab_points <- empty_correlation_plot(
    paste0(analysis_config$label, " IMC protein score vs Xenium scMetabolism")
  )
  p_protein_scmetab_bins <- empty_correlation_plot(
    paste0(analysis_config$label, " binned IMC protein vs scMetabolism correlation")
  )
}

save_plot_set(
  p_protein_scmetab_points,
  paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_protein_scmetabolism_correlation_points"),
  width = 8.2,
  height = 5.2
)
save_plot_set(
  p_protein_scmetab_bins,
  paste0(analysis_config$file_prefix, "_protein_scmetabolism_correlation_bins"),
  width = 8.2,
  height = 5.2
)

p_protein_scmetab_points
p_protein_scmetab_bins
```
